title: Every drawing, waiting list and scored round found
question: Which permits, licences, homes, spaces, grants and task work are handed out by a drawing, a queue, a rotation or a scored round, and what does each publish about who entered and who won?
finding: 37 such systems were found: 7 publish both entrants and winners, 1 published entrants but needed no drawing, 3 publish pool members and spending, 2 publish ticket numbers only, 6 publish winners only, and 14 publish counts or nothing. 4 more are listed for completeness and turned out not to be drawings. The rule is quoted from the publisher’s own document in 17 rows and summarised in the rest.
how: One row per system in the download’s inventory, which was built from each publisher’s pages and documents. The rule is shown in quotation marks only when the same words were found in the saved copy of the document; otherwise it is marked as a summary. The "what can be tested" column sorts each system by what it publishes: entrants and winners, winners only, ticket numbers, counts, or nothing. Abbreviations in the inventory are spelt out.
limits: The inventory is what one download found in a day, not a census of every allocation in City government: Public Utilities Commission and Airport pools, school assignment files and several State lists were not fetched. "Not published" means not found on the publisher’s site, not that the record does not exist. A system that publishes nothing is not thereby suspect: lists of housing, shelter and benefit applicants are private for good reason. Summaries are the download’s wording, not the publisher’s.

rows.drawing: California Department of Housing and Community Development competitive programs (Multifamily Housing Program, No Place Like Home, Portfolio Reinvestment Program, Infill Infrastructure Grant, Transitional Age Youth, Multifamily Housing Program gap)
rows.runBy: California Department of Housing and Community Development
rows.allocates: state housing loans/grants
rows.rule: In summary: scored funding notice rounds
rows.testable: Entrants and winners both published

rows.drawing: Condominium conversion lottery
rows.runBy: Public Works - Bureau of Street-Use & Mapping (Subdivision Code Art. 9)
rows.allocates: annual conversion slots for 2-6 unit buildings
rows.rule: In summary: annual lottery with ticket pools by years of owner occupancy (Subdivision Code 1396.1); suspended by section 1396.5 The document says: “Suspension of the lottery through January 1, 2024 (as mandated by Section 1396.5)”
rows.entrants: yes 2001-2013 (the City’s open-data site h9dp-7wd4, on disk in another folder of this project
rows.testable: Entrants and winners both published

rows.drawing: Powered scooter share permits

rows.rule: “Applicants must receive an average score of 2 or greater for each section, or will be disqualified from further evaluation.”
rows.testable: Entrants and winners both published

rows.drawing: Priority drawing for Neighborhood-Restricted Special On-Sale General licences (Type 87), San Francisco
rows.runBy: California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control
rows.allocates: new on-sale liquor licences for bona fide eating places in specified San Francisco census tracts (5 per year 2019-2026)
rows.rule: “the department will randomly select the order of the randomized numbers establishing a priority order for all priority applicants”
rows.frequency: yearly (application window Sept, virtual drawing Oct)
rows.entrants: yes - current cycle only (names, Alcoholic Beverage Control application no.)
rows.testable: Entrants and winners both published

rows.drawing: Priority drawing for original general licences (types 21/47/48/57/75)
rows.runBy: California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control
rows.allocates: new general liquor licences by county population ratio
rows.rule: In summary: random priority order when applicants exceed licences
rows.testable: Entrants and winners both published

rows.allocates: federal and state housing tax credits, bond allocation
rows.rule: In summary: competitive point scores and tie-breakers (California Tax Credit Allocation Committee regulations, not fetched)

rows.drawing: Taxi Medallion Sales Pilot Program (2010-) buyers/sellers
